old_caption: The video showcases a dynamic sequence involving a series of colorful dominoes arranged in a wave-like pattern on a flat surface. The dominoes are primarily blue and gray, with yellow supports beneath them. The scene begins static. The collapse initiates with the blue and gray dominoes on the left side falling, which causes the yellow supports beneath them to collapse. The falling pieces collapse downward and accumulate at the base, creating a localized collapse confined to the left side of the structure. The background remains static, providing a neutral setting that highlights the movement and color contrast of the dominoes.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a dynamic sequence involving a series of colorful dominoes arranged in a wave-like pattern on a flat surface. The dominoes are primarily blue and gray, with yellow supports beneath them. As the video progresses, a single blue domino is launched from the left side of the frame, rolling towards the center. Upon reaching the wave formation, it collides with the dominoes, causing a chain reaction. The wave of dominoes begins to topple sequentially, creating a cascading effect. The falling dominoes scatter across the surface, with some falling vertically and others horizontally, forming a chaotic yet visually engaging scene. The background remains static, providing a neutral setting that highlights the movement and color contrast of the dominoes. The video captures the energy and momentum of the dominoes as they interact with each other, culminating in a visually satisfying display of physics and motion.
caption: The video showcases a stop-motion-style assembly of plastic building blocks on a wooden surface against a pale wooden backdrop. A wavy cyan platform rests on six evenly spaced vertical yellow columns, with short gray dominoes standing upright along its top edge. To the right, upright gray dominoes line the ground; to the left, a flat row sits beside a transparent panel. The scene holds still, then the transparent panel tips over and drops to the ground. Soon after, the leftmost yellow column buckles, the left end of the cyan platform dips and detaches, and the column collapses onto the surface, scattering cyan and gray pieces leftward into a growing debris pile. The failure propagates rightward as the second column leans, buckles, and falls, dragging down the left platform and toppling the gray dominoes above it toward the left. The right-side columns remain upright and the right domino row stays in place. The excerpt ends mid-collapse, with the sagging platform and debris still settling.

Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
